'''''Avatar's Needle''''' was a [[Guardian-class light cruiser|''Guardian''-class light cruiser]] owned and operated by the [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Shanto Dhil]]. A former [[Imperial Office of Customs/Legends|Imperial Customs]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]], Dhil refused to divulge how he obtained the ship. Dhil personally modified the vessel at [[Port Bianco/Legends|Port Bianco]], expanding the cargo capacity by removing the existing hold and brige and replacing it with half-spherical cradle designed to connect with the storage tanks used by bacta transports.<ref name="LE" />
